propositions: close_precheck does not validate that a bug closed as duplicate has a recorded duplicates link, allowing the completion verifier to fail with no actionable remediation
when _has_live_replacement_link returns False for a duplicate close, the gate falls through to the LLM verifier instead of raising a deterministic error naming the missing rebar link command
the gate must distinguish between a duplicates link that names an unresolvable/archived target versus no link recorded at all, offering different error messages for each case
a duplicates link targeting a closed canonical ticket must be accepted as valid (link existence required, not target openness)
the hard-fail check must apply only to duplicate class, not to not_a_bug or escalated, since those classes have no canonical counterpart requiring a duplicates link
